description: Create a new user-level or project-level EASY CODE Skill as a SKILL.md workflow with optional supporting text files. Existing Skills are never overwritten.

propertyDescriptions.scope: Choose user for all projects or project for the current project's shared Skill directory.
propertyDescriptions.name: Lowercase Skill directory name, unique within the selected scope.
propertyDescriptions.description: Concise routing description: what the Skill does and when it should or should not activate.
propertyDescriptions.instructions: Main SKILL.md workflow: required inputs, ordered steps, outputs, verification and stop conditions.
propertyDescriptions.files: Optional supporting text files inside this Skill.
propertyDescriptions.files[].path: Safe relative path, commonly under references/, assets/ or scripts/.
propertyDescriptions.files[].content: Full UTF-8 text content of the supporting file.

guidance: Create one focused Skill only when the user asks to save a reusable workflow. Prefer instructions over scripts; scripts do not execute on creation.
